image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a vintage typewriter keyboard. The focus is on the bottom row of keys, specifically highlighting the elongated space bar which is cream-colored and rectangular. Above it are rows of round, black typewriter keys with white characters. The background shows the metallic carriage and type guide mechanism of the typewriter.
